verdict.rationale: Base44 is a platform with an SDK and CLI, so asking for a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt documentation index, the MCP servers and the SDK docs are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
